date.source: The newsletter's own issue number and preview date: 'VCW Preview 70, Part 2' is dated 5 September 1996, immediately followed by 'VCW Online #70, "Fall From Grace"' itself; both, with the preceding VCW Online #69 (26 August 1996), survive only as a verbatim reprint inside another federation's (AWI's) own 2 November 1996 post.

appearances.note: Billed in the Cup's Ring 6 bout against 'The Strutter' T.R. Parker of the KWF, an interfederation guest this collection holds no separate character record for; pinned by a top-rope bulldog at 3:53.

Billed in the Cup's Ring 8 bout against the Crystal Crow, representing the AWI, an interfederation guest this collection holds no separate character record for; pinned by a Tiger's Pounce scissors piledriver at 20:24.
Accompanied Bodybreaker Hal Johnston to the ring for his Nine Worthies Cup bout.
Entered the ring afterward to present the Cup of the Nine Worthies to its winner.

matches.stipulation: Cup of the Nine Worthies, Ring 4
matches.note: The Haze pinned Showtime at 10:34 after a bridged spinebuster attempt collapsed on Showtime's already-injured ribs; commentary called the result 'not all that shocking' given the champion's home-field advantage.

matches.stipulation: Cup of the Nine Worthies, Ring 2
matches.note: Fury submitted the Electric Youth with the Jackhammer at 11:33, after wearing him down with a sleeperhold.

matches.stipulation: Cup of the Nine Worthies, Ring 1
matches.note: Johnston pinned the Gorilla with a top-rope move called 'Cement Boots' at 14:03. Both men had been rebilled into this pairing after their original, separately-announced opponents (Powerhouse Pruitt and Lord Ferral) dropped out.

matches.stipulation: Cup of the Nine Worthies, Ring 5
matches.note: Machismo pinned Running Eagle Feather with a Powerdriver at 19:51, after reversing an early gorilla-press/backbreaker combination.

matches.stipulation: Cup of the Nine Worthies, center-ring gauntlet among the eight ring-winners
matches.note: The bracket's other two ring-winners were interfederation guests this collection holds no separate character record for: 'The Strutter' T.R. Parker (KWF) and, representing the AWI, the Crystal Crow. Parker eliminated the Purple Haze and, with Jack Fury's help, Bodybreaker Hal Johnston, both by Struttersault; Derek Machismo and the Crystal Crow were both counted out after a backdrop spilled them together outside the ring. Parker then pinned Jack Fury with a sunset flip at 34:44 to win the Cup, its cash prize, and an invitation to the following year's tournament.
